_comment: DepthViT on CIFAR-100 -- general (non-calorimeter) image-dataset evidence that the channel-asymmetric approach is not a calorimeter artifact. Budget is anchored to its own matched ViT baseline, NOT to the jets 5.4M tier: k_factor=61 gives 5,323,575 params against ViT(D=192,L=12,h=3) at 5,380,132, a 1.06% gap with DepthViT as the SMALLER model -- the conservative direction, so no win can be attributed to a budget advantage. Both counts verified by building the nn.Module. patch_size=4 on 32x32 -> an 8x8 token grid (64 tokens); hap_window_size=4 divides it into 2x2 windows, mirroring the jets layout. mlp_dim stays PINNED at 768 exactly as in every jets tier. n_channels=3 is RGB, not ECAL/HCAL, so CrossDepthMultiheadSelfAttention runs 3x3 attention with k parallel slices instead of 2x2.

model._comment: ONLY differences vs configs/jets_150p_5M_90epoch.json: patch_size 10->4, k_factor 90->61, max_image_* 100->32, hap_window_size 5->4. n_layers, mlp_dim, linear_rank, num_hap_layers, dropout and all HAP settings held identical. hidden_dim = 3*61 = 183.

trainer._comment: accumulate_grad_batches=1 (not 4 as on jets): 50k images at gbs=512 is only 97 optimizer steps/epoch, so accumulation would starve the schedule. Per-rank batches = 50000 // 512 = 97 = DepthViTModule._steps_per_epoch(), so the cosine schedule lines up exactly.

phases.name: cls_finetune
phases._comment: 90 epochs, matching every other run in the project. warmup_steps=400: the jets configs use 5000 warmup steps at 620000/512 = 1211 steps/epoch, i.e. ~4.1 epochs of warmup. CIFAR-100 runs 50000/512 = 97 steps/epoch, so ~4.1 epochs is ~400 steps. Carrying 5000 over literally would put warmup at 51 of the 90 epochs.
